note: Short checklists FIRN reads out rather than reinvents. Edit freely. Nothing here states the law: rules on winter tyres, chains, warning triangles and hi-vis differ by country and change, so the lists say 'check the rule' and FIRN looks it up.

predrive.title: Before setting off
items: tyres: no visible damage, pressures right for the load
lights and indicators all working; windows, mirrors and cameras clean
washer fluid topped up, wipers clearing properly
fuel or charge for the trip plus a reserve
phone charged, cable in the car, route loaded while there is still signal
documents: licence, registration, insurance; passport or ID if a border is involved
load secured, nothing loose on the parcel shelf
seat, mirrors and head restraint set before moving, not after
first stop decided: where, and after how long

winter.title: Winter kit and habits
items: scraper and brush; de-icer; washer fluid rated for the cold
warm layer, gloves and a blanket within reach of the seats, not in the boot under the luggage
torch, power bank, water and something to eat
shovel and a traction aid if the route climbs
tyres: winter-rated, with tread to spare; check the rule on winter tyres and chains for every country on the route
start with more fuel or charge than usual: cold and a traffic jam both eat range
clear all the glass and the roof before moving; snow on the roof becomes the next driver's windscreen
double the following gap on snow, and more on ice; bridges and shaded stretches freeze first
smooth inputs: brake in a straight line, steer gently, no cruise control on a slippery road

longhaul.title: A long drive
items: sleep properly the night before; do not start a long leg tired
a break every two hours, fifteen minutes out of the seat
water in reach; eat light
fuel or charge stops chosen in advance, with a second choice for each
arrival buffer planned: the timetable should survive one closed road
someone at the other end knows the ETA
if the yawns start, stop: a twenty-minute nap beats an open window

airport.title: An airport run
items: passport or ID in date; visa or travel authorisation if the destination needs one
boarding passes saved offline; check-in and bag-drop closing times noted
bag sizes and weights inside the carrier's limits; liquids and power banks where the rules want them
leave-by time worked out backwards from the gate, not forwards from the sofa
parking or drop-off decided; a plan B if the usual road is shut
payment card that works abroad, a little local cash, plug adapter
the clock at the far end: when to sleep and eat on arrival-day time
someone knows the flight number

ev.title: An electric trip
items: charge to the level the plan assumes before leaving
charge stops chosen with a second choice near each one
the apps or cards those chargers need, set up and tested before the trip
own cable in the car if the destination has only a socket or a tethered-less post
in the cold: pre-heat the cabin and the pack while still plugged in
arrive at each stop with a margin, not at zero; a broken charger should be an inconvenience, not a tow
charging at the destination confirmed, or enough left to reach the next charger

breakdown.title: If the car stops
items: hazard lights on; get the car as far off the carriageway as it will go
hi-vis on before getting out; everyone out on the side away from traffic and behind the barrier
warning triangle well back from the car where the road and the local rule allow it; never on a motorway lane
call for help: road number, direction of travel, nearest marker post or junction
do not stand between the car and the traffic, or between two vehicles
stay warm and stay visible while waiting; do not attempt repairs at the roadside in traffic

sim.title: Before a simulation
items: brief agreed and locked: ruleset, forces, terrain, weather, objective, win, loss, time limit, modules fitted
the fit list checked: nothing in play that is not fitted
the ledger started and its state line carried from turn to turn
the seed noted, so the same sim can be run again
chance decided by dice with the odds stated first, never by feel
short turns, each ending on a decision for the driver
an after-action report at the end, and one log line worth keeping
